text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, as expected of the Queen!! Talk 
about an overwhelming difference in power!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's right. I'm the number one 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"So this victory is only natural. 
Naturally, I'm first... I came in 
first..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I should be so happy, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, but still... grrr~!! I really wish 
Vodka had been in this Yushun Himba, too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, totally!! Vodka and Scarlet's race! I 
really wanted to see that, too~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm number one, I couldn't 
help but feel like something's still 
missing...!

Daiwa Scarlet, brilliantly crowned as the 
Queen of the Oaks.

—Having gone through this stage, the 
unease she felt seemed to be becoming 
clearer.

"...If it's right now, perhaps I can make 
her and 'that girl' face each other."
